duty.en: It's our duty to keep the classroom clean.
duty.cn: 保持教室干净是我们的职责。

water.en: Don't forget to water the flowers every day.
water.cn: 不要忘了每天给花浇水。

plant.en: Plants need water and sunlight to grow.
plant.cn: 植物需要水和阳光才能生长。

wipe.en: I wipe the windows until they shine.
wipe.cn: 我把窗户擦得闪闪发亮。

window.en: The bird is singing outside the window.

sweep.en: We sweep the classroom after class every day.
sweep.cn: 我们每天下课后扫教室。

floor.en: Don't run on the wet floor.
We sit on the floor to read stories together.
floor.cn: 我们坐在地板上一起读故事。

help.en: I help my mum at home.
Helping others makes me feel happy.
help.cn: 帮助别人让我感到快乐。
